description: This file defines a React component 'InstructorCoTeacherModal' that provides a modal dialog interface with an AI-powered chat assistant for instructors to ask questions related to course management, grading, and student progress. It handles state management for messages, input, loading, and errors, and integrates with an external API 'chatWithInstructorBot'. The component includes UI elements such as header, message display area, input form, and close button.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Handles sending user messages to the AI chat bot and updating the message history with the response or error message.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, invoking sendMessage with the current input value.
